csv_scope_of_work: The City of Sebastian is accepting proposals for 26-16- RFQ, Continuing Engineering Services for Sebastian Municipal Airport. The purpose of this Request for Qualification (RFQ) is to select the most highly qualified Aviation-oriented engineering firm(s) to provide Continuing Engineering Services. The scope of services is anticipated to include, but not be limited to, planning, master plan update, feasibility and economic study, runway and taxiway design, runway safety, taxiway construction, runway and taxiway rehabilitation, airfield lighting, runway signage and markings, hangar design, parking lot and other aviation improvements within the Sebastian Municipal Airport.
